mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_callback_config (merchant_id, callback_url, event_types, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{callbackUrl}, #{eventTypes}, #{status}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE callback_url = VALUES(callback_url), event_types = VALUES(event_types), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
